question: Should CodexBar add and maintain DeepInfra as a first-class API-token provider in the core provider catalog?
rationale: The patch is a new user-facing provider capability, so technical correctness and proof do not establish the repository's desired long-term support scope.

options.title: Sponsor core support
options.body: Accept DeepInfra as a maintained provider and merge after required checks pass on the current head.

options.title: Defer provider scope
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it with a clear explanation that the project is not accepting this provider surface now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor core support
recommendation.body: Accept DeepInfra as a maintained provider and merge after required checks pass on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent branch integration work and repository ownership signals make them the best available decision route.
